plan: possession-v2.5b (v2.5 with the coarse alignment anchored on the on-screen match clock)
motivation: The team proposed aligning the two recordings with the clock shown in both videos (automatic OCR already exists: S002, tools/clock_observations.py). While the registered v2.5 evaluation was running, one of its first copies (J03WN1 seed 2101, accurate 'good' broadcast) failed to align: the v4 whole-match ball cross-correlation chose a wrong axis flip at a spurious lag, so no broadcast frame was accepted and the fill was lost. This plan was written after seeing the first v2.5 rows (the exact number read from exp_v25.json at registration is recorded in seen_v2_5_rows) and is confirmed on new copies only.

candidate.clock_lags: possession/clocksync.py: runs/anchors from development/clock_alignment.py (S002 logic, registered S002 values: min confidence 0.8, max sample gap 15 s, residual 1.1 s, >= 3 samples over >= 10 s per run, unique runs only); per tactical half the median anchor lag if >= 10 anchors with IQR <= 1.5 s
candidate.alignment: if every half has a clock lag: orient_at (axis flips by the median ball distance at the clock lags, team mapping by player matching there) and align_at (v4 window refinement, coarse-to-fine search +-40 frames around the clock lag, same acceptance check); otherwise the unchanged v4 orient/align
candidate.unchanged: accuracy gate (median ball distance <= 0.50 m, >= 120 s overlap, >= 5% accepted), fill rule, v2.4 noise gate, models and decoders

validation.tactical_copies: 16 NEW copies of the four validation matches: degrade seeds 3100 + 10*i + j (v2.1 corruption) and 3500 + 10*i + j (+ player noise 0.3-0.6 m), i = match index, j = 0/1
validation.broadcast_streams: synth_broadcast2.simulate_with_clock (identical stream generator, plus the live time shown by the clock), stream seed 19000 + 100*regime_index + copy_index, the three v2.5 accuracy regimes
validation.clock_observations: synth_clock.observations for both videos, every 5 s from a random phase, readable with p_read ~ U(0.5, 0.95) per video, misread p ~ U(0.01, 0.03), first-half added time overlapping second-half clock values; seed 29000 + 100*regime_index + copy_index

select_v2_5b_only_if_all: good regime: v2.5b mean >= v2.5 mean - 0.002 (same copies)
good regime: copies with accepted broadcast fraction < 5% (alignment failures) for v2.5b <= for v2.5
selection_rule.otherwise: v2.5 or v2.4 according to the v2.5 plan

limits_stated_in_advance: Clock readings are simulated; on the real videos the S002 OCR is used, whose accuracy was not measured against independent truth.
Replays keep the live clock while showing old pictures; they are rejected by the player-position acceptance, as in v4.
The organisers' reproduction then needs the separate OCR environment (requirements-sync-lock.txt) and both videos; without clock files the pipeline falls back to the tracking-only alignment.
